responsibility: This public header exposes the SPARC VIS intrinsic API to C/C++ code. It defines the vector and integer types used by VIS operations and wraps GCC’s SPARC VIS builtins in inline functions gated by the available __VIS__ level, covering GSR access, alignment, pack/merge/multiply, edge, compare, arithmetic, and later VIS3/VIS4 operations so source programs can request SPARC multimedia instructions in a stable header interface.
